overview: Katta Lower is the residential and merchant heart of Katta Castellum, supporting the Loyalist civic structure through trade, craftsmanship, and daily life.
history: Built as the foundational district of the Loyalist city-state.
Designed with terraced housing and orderly streets to reflect civic stability.
Merchant Row became the city’s primary trade artery.
Arcane regulators were installed to maintain infrastructure harmony.
hooks: A merchant reports unusual arcane interference in their shop.
A census officer requests help verifying residential records.
A terrace collapse threatens the lower walkways.
A caravan arrives with goods from Shadow Haven.
